text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Malaysia employs over 3,000 Jordanians in various fields; Prime Minister Abdul Salam al-Majali concludes visit to Malaysia and both sides express their commitment to a just Middle East peace and support of Palestinian rights.
- New appointments and transfers of judges within the judicial sytem.
- Deputy Toujan Faisal says the Palace will intervene to end the crisis brought about by the Islamist decision to boycott parliamentary elections due next November.
- Jordan says it is tightening regulations on granting work permits to foreign workers.
- Queen Noor flies to Belguim to condole air show crash victims.
- King calls on nation to stand against disunity.
- Extremists should not be allowed to impose agenda - Crown Prince Hassan.
